decision: MV14 execution requires the existing version-captured R runtime.
mirt remains the primary external psychometric runtime.
multipleGroup is required for the core E-DAIC/CMDC model ladder.
DIF is useful as a documented reference path; the MV13 one-free model ladder remains acceptable if DIF is unavailable.
boot.mirt enables optional aggregate SE-availability sensitivity.
boot.LR enables optional parametric LRT sensitivity.
The design can be complete even if optional bootstrap helpers are missing, but the execution run must version-capture any fallback.
